description: Run a read-only SQL SELECT against OECD observation tables staged on a DataCanvas by oecd_query_dataset. Call oecd_dataframe_describe first to discover exact table and column names, then use this tool for aggregation, filtering, GROUP BY, JOIN, and window functions. Only available when CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE=duckdb is set.

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID returned by oecd_query_dataset — exactly 10 characters of letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores. Identifies the DataCanvas session holding the observation tables.

sql.description: Read-only SELECT statement. Reference tables by the names returned by oecd_dataframe_describe. Only SELECT statements are allowed — DDL, DML, and file-reading functions are rejected.

name: oecd_dataframe_query

column_names.description: Column names in the result, in order.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `canvas_disabled`: DataCanvas is not configured — CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE is unset. `canvas_not_found`: The canvas_id has expired or was never created. `table_not_found`: The SQL names a table this canvas does not hold — it expired, was dropped, or the name is wrong. `invalid_sql`: The SQL is not a valid SELECT statement or contains disallowed operations. `sql_execution_error`: The SQL parsed and ran, then failed on the staged observation data — a conversion, an invalid input, or a value out of range. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

row_count.description: Full result count before any row cap.

rows.description: Result rows from the SQL query (capped at the canvas row limit).

title: Oecd Dataframe Query
